1. Accepting these terms

These terms are an agreement between you and [PLACEHOLDER: company legal name] ("we"). They cover the Atüned app, the pages at atuned.world and your account.

You accept them when you press a button that says you agree, create an account, or use the app. If you do not accept them, do not use Atüned.

The Privacy policy is part of these terms. Read it too.

2. What Atüned is

Atüned is a self report instrument. You record stories and answer questions. The engine reads where charge sits in what you gave it, and the app shows you the result. It reads what you entered and nothing else.

A reading is a reading of your own words and answers. It is not a score, and it is not a finding about your body.

3. What Atüned is not

Atüned is not medical care. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any disease or condition. It cannot see a disease, an injury or a deficiency. The words for the body are anatomical because charge sits somewhere. Nothing was scanned or measured.

It is not therapy. It does not replace a doctor, a therapist or a prescription. Nothing in it is medical or psychological advice. It has not been reviewed by the Food and Drug Administration, and no reading has been tested in a clinical trial.

Decisions about your health belong with a licensed professional. If you are under care, stay under it. Nothing Atüned prints is a reason to stop a treatment or change a dose.

If a reading lands hard, take it to a professional, and take the reading with you.

4. In danger now

Atüned is not an emergency service. We do not read what you write as you write it. Nobody is monitoring it, so nobody will know you are in danger.

If you are thinking about ending your life, or you do not feel safe, contact a crisis line now. In the United States, call or text 988 for the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or chat at 988lifeline.org. Outside the United States, use your local emergency number. People trained for exactly this answer. Help is available.

5. Who may use it

You must be [PLACEHOLDER: age floor. Proposed: 18] or older. Atüned is not directed at children. If we learn that someone under that age has an account, we delete it.

You must be able to enter an agreement where you live. You must not be barred from using the service by law.

6. Accounts

You can use Atüned without an account. An account is for keeping a copy of your record on our server, for paying, and for the features that need them.

To create an account you give an email address and a password of 8 to 200 characters. [CHECK: the shipped sign up takes an email address and a password and has no username. If a username is added, it is 3 to 20 characters, and this paragraph should say so. Delete this note if no username is added.]

Keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account. If you think someone else has it, change the password and write to us.

One account is for one person. Do not share it, sell it or hand it on.

Atüned has a free plan and four paid plans. Paid plans are billed monthly, in US dollars.

What each plan includes is on the buy page at atuned.world. The plan you buy is the one shown when you pay. [PLACEHOLDER: whether prices include or exclude tax. Stripe can add tax at checkout if it is switched on.]

Payment goes through Stripe. You type your card into Stripe's page only. We never see your card number. Stripe's own terms apply to the payment. We get from Stripe your customer id, your subscription id, your plan, its status and its dates.

If a payment fails, Stripe tries again for a period. If it still fails, your plan drops to free. Your record stays.

We may change a price. We will tell you at least [PLACEHOLDER: days] before it applies to you. If you do not accept the new price, cancel before it starts.

9. What you write

You own what you write and what you answer. We do not claim it.

You give us a licence to hold it, process it and show it back to you, for as long as you have an account, so we can run the service you asked for. The licence ends when you delete your account, except for the copies described in the Privacy policy under how long we keep data.

We do not use your writing for anything else unless you turn on research sharing. If you do, you give us permission to use a copy of your imprints, releases and readings in aggregate, as the Privacy policy describes. You can turn it off at any time.

Do not write about other people in a way that identifies them if you would not want it held. Your story is yours, but a name typed into it is held with the rest.

We give you a personal, non exclusive licence to use Atüned for yourself. It cannot be transferred and we can end it under section 18.

You may not resell it, rent it, sublicense it, or present what it prints as a clinical assessment.

11. Acceptable use

Do not:

  • break the law with Atüned
  • try to get into another person's account or record
  • probe, overload or break the service, or get around a limit on it
  • copy, scrape or resell the engine's content, or the readings, at scale
  • reverse engineer the app to build a competing product
  • use it to harass or threaten anyone
  • present a reading as medical, psychological or legal advice to someone else

The tiers limit what is drawn on the screen. The record is on your device and you can edit your own record. Doing that to get what a plan sells is a breach of these terms.

12. Practitioners and cohorts

A practitioner, which includes a coach, can see part of your record only if you grant it, as the Privacy policy describes. You choose each grant and you can take it back at once.

We are not a party to what passes between you and a practitioner. We do not check their licence or their advice. A practitioner is responsible for staying inside their own licence and their own law. Atüned does not assess mental function, and a practitioner must not describe it as if it did. [CHECK: this describes a feature that is not built yet. Keep it only when it ships.]
